acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Guest host Aviva DeKornfeld tells Ira Glass about breaking into a community pool as a kid, and the split-second decision that has haunted her ever since.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Some people are great in a crisis. Others, not so much. Does that mean anything about who we really are? Tobin Low investigates.
acts.title: On Top of Spaghetti, All Covered in Shame

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Aviva DeKornfeld has the story of Leisha Hailey, who was certain she had the next million-dollar idea.
acts.title: BWE: Big Wig Energy

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Comedian Mike Birbiglia talks about the questions his daughter asks him and how trying to answer them showed him surprising reflections of himself.
This is an excerpt from Mike Birbiglia’s special, “ The Good Life.”
acts.title: There Will Be Questions

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: David Kestenbaum tells the story of the suspicious disappearance of multiple shoes and a woman determined to explain it.
acts.title: Trouble Afoot
